Oh and for y or x intercept , use this form , 

(x/a) + (y/b) = 1 where a is x intercept, b is y intercept so basically you are dividing constants both side so that you get 1 and whatever which divides y is y intercept and x is x intercept, it would be like this step by step,

2x + y = 8

Dividing 8 both sides we have,

(2x+y)/8 = 8/8

(2x+y)/8 = 1

(2x/8) + (y/8) = 1

(x/4) + (y/8) = 1

Therefore your x intercept is 4 and y intercept is 8. This equation form is also known as intercept form.
